```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(googledrive)
library(lubridate)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(fluxfinder)

RAW_DIR <- "Raw_Data/"

MSMT_LENGTH <- 90

RAW_DIR <- "Raw_Data/"
PROCESSED_DIR <- "Processed_Data"

# Metadata file produced by script 1
PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, 
                                  "SoilFluxes_8100_Metadata_processed_final.parquet")
# Clock offset files produced by script 2
PLOT_OFFSET_FILE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "offsets-plot-specific.csv")
COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "offsets-collar-specific.csv")

# The output of this script: computed fluxes
FLUX_FILE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "SoilFluxes.parquet")
```

## Load metadata

```{r}
message("Reading ", basename(PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL))
read_parquet(PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL) |> 
    mutate(start_time = ymd_hms(start_time, tz = "EST"),
           end_time = ymd_hms(end_time, tz = "EST"),
           Vtotal = as.numeric(Vtotal)) ->
    md_all
message("\tMetadata file is ", nrow(md_all), " x ", ncol(md_all))
message("\tRemoving empty dates")
md_all |> 
    mutate(Date = date(start_time)) |> 
    filter(!is.na(Date)) ->
    md_all
message("Metadata file is ", nrow(md_all), " x ", ncol(md_all))
message("\tDate range: ", min(md_all$Date), " to ", max(md_all$Date))

message("Reading ", PLOT_OFFSET_FILE)
plot_offsets <- read_csv(PLOT_OFFSET_FILE, col_types = "Dcdc")
message("\tPlot offset file is ", nrow(plot_offsets), " x ", ncol(plot_offsets))

if(file.exists(COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE)) {
    message("Reading ", COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE)
    collar_offsets <- read_csv(COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE, col_types = "Dcd")
    message("\tCollar offset file is ", nrow(collar_offsets), " x ", ncol(collar_offsets))
} else {
    message("No collar offset file")
    collar_offsets <- tibble(Date = Date(0), label = character(0), collar_offset = NA_real_)
}

if(file.exists(FLUX_FILE)) {
    message("Reading ", FLUX_FILE)
    fluxes <- read_parquet()
    message("\tFlux file is ", nrow(fluxes), " x ", ncol(fluxes))
} else {
    message("No flux file")
    fluxes <- tibble()
}
```

# Load climate data

```{r climate-data}
wx_files <- list.files("weather_data/", 
                       pattern = "GCW_W_[0-9]{4}_wx-tempavg15_L2.*.parquet$", 
                       full.names = TRUE)
wx_data <- list()
for(f in wx_files) {
    message("Reading ", basename(f))
    read_parquet(f) |>
        mutate(TIMESTAMP = force_tz(TIMESTAMP, tzone = "EST")) |> 
        group_by(Site, Plot, TIMESTAMP) |> 
        summarise(Value_MAC = mean(Value_MAC), .groups = "drop") -> x
    
    wx_data[[unique(year(x$TIMESTAMP))]] <- x
}
```

# Data matching and flux computation

```{r}

dates_to_process <- unique(md_all$Date)
# TESTING ONLY -- do just one date
# Comment this out for real use!
dates_to_process <- ymd("2024-08-09") 

for(i in seq_along(dates_to_process)) {
    d <- dates_to_process[i]
    message(i, "/", length(dates_to_process), ": ", d)
    md_all |> 
        filter(Date == d) ->
        md_this
    message("\t", nrow(md_this), " fluxes")
    
    # Read the day-specific file prepared by script 1
    li7810file <- file.path(RAW_DIR, paste0("LI7810_", gsub("-", "", d), ".parquet"))
    if(file.exists(li7810file)) {
        li7810dat <- read_parquet(li7810file)
        li7810dat$TIMESTAMP <- force_tz(li7810dat$TIMESTAMP, "EST")
    } else {
        warning("No concentration data available for ", d)
        next
    }
    message("\tconcentration data file is ", nrow(li7810dat), " x ", ncol(li7810dat))
    
    # Get offset information and check for anything missing
    md_this |> 
        left_join(plot_offsets, by = c("Plot", "Date"), relationship = "many-to-one")|> 
        left_join(collar_offsets, by = c("Date", "label"), relationship = "many-to-one") |> 
        mutate(final_clock_offset = if_else(is.na(collar_offset), Clock_offset, collar_offset),
               Flux_CO2 = NA_real_, Flux_CH4 = NA_real_, wx_tair = NA_real_) -> 
        md_this_offsets
    
    if(any(is.na(md_this_offsets$final_clock_offset))) {
        md_this_offsets |> 
            filter(is.na(final_clock_offset)) |> 
            pull(Plot) |> 
            unique() -> 
            missing_plots
        warning("Plots (", paste(missing_plots, collapse = ", "), 
                ") do not have offset information! Skipping this day")
        next
    }
    
    message("\tloading air temperature data")
    wx_thisyear <- wx_data[[year(d)]]
    if(is.null(wx_thisyear)) {
        warning("No data available for this year!")
        next
    }
    
    co2_fluxes <- list()
    ch4_fluxes <- list()
    for(msmt in seq_len(nrow(md_this_offsets))) {
        this_start <- md_this_offsets$start_time[msmt]
        this_offset <- md_this_offsets$final_clock_offset[msmt]
        this_label <- md_this_offsets$label[msmt]
        this_vol <- md_this_offsets$Vtotal[msmt] / 100^3 # m3
        this_pressure <- md_this_offsets$Pressure[msmt]
        
        # Find the air temperature corresponding to these data
        this_tair <- wx_thisyear$Value_MAC[which.min(abs(this_start - wx_thisyear$TIMESTAMP))]
        
        # Isolate, based on the clock offsets for this day and plot, 
        # the LI-7810 concentration data for this row of the metadata
        # table (i.e., for this label=collar and plot)
        li7810dat |> 
            filter(TIMESTAMP >= this_start + this_offset, 
                   TIMESTAMP <= this_start + this_offset + MSMT_LENGTH) |>  
            # convert gas concentrations to µmol (CO2) or nmol (CH4)
            mutate(
                CO2_umol = ffi_ppm_to_umol(CO2, 
                                           volume = this_vol,
                                           temp = this_tair,
                                           atm = this_pressure),
                CH4_nmol = ffi_ppb_to_nmol(CH4, 
                                          volume = this_vol,
                                          temp = this_tair,
                                          atm = this_pressure)
            ) ->
            this_7810data
        # Compute fluxes. Because of the process used in 2-Clock_Offsets.R,
        # we set don't use deadband as that's already been accounted for
        md_this_offsets$wx_tair[msmt] <- this_tair
        co2f <- ffi_compute_fluxes(this_7810data,
                                   group_column = NULL, 
                                   time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                                   gas_column = "CO2_umol")
        colnames(co2f) <- paste0("co2_", colnames(co2f))
        co2_fluxes[[msmt]] <- co2f
        
        ch4f <- ffi_compute_fluxes(this_7810data,
                                   group_column = NULL, 
                                   time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                                   gas_column = "CH4_nmol")
        colnames(ch4f) <- paste0("ch4_", colnames(ch4f))
        ch4_fluxes[[msmt]] <- ch4f
        
        
    }
    
    # TODO: script 2 needs to include 7810SN in the metadata
    # Then we use that here
    
}

```
